'''Nanika Senoj''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Senoj and the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Dwanar Gher]] were wanted by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] for helping to rescue some wanted criminals from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities. Senoj once had a relationship with the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] smuggler [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]].
